findings.message: Accept the Apple API key ID as a create option. When creating an iOS destination with API-key authentication in CI, this command always exits with “You must provide the Apple API Key ID” after uploading the key file. `appleApiKeyId` is initialized to `undefined`, but is neither declared in the options schema nor read from `options`, so callers cannot supply it. Add the option and initialize this variable from it so non-interactive creation can succeed.
